description: A smaller span does not shrink the line either: a 10px span among 16px text under a 40px line-height makes a 42px line.

classification.reason: Measured against Chrome 155 on Windows: 1.78% of the pixels differ and the box matches exactly; what is left is the two engines' glyph antialiasing, as in the other text fixtures. Before each run's line box was measured on its own, the same fixture measured 4.1% and the box is 2px short, so it fails.
